description: Every SentinelOne v2.1 endpoint plus offline cross-tenant fleet health and threat triage.

novel_features.name: Overnight Drift
novel_features.description: One answer to 'what changed across all my tenants since I logged off?' — new threats, newly-offline or newly-unhealthy agents, version regressions, and protection-mode flips. Needs at least 2 syncs of local history.

novel_features.name: Threat Recurrence Hunter
novel_features.description: Surfaces threats whose same hash or name re-appears across endpoints — or returns on an endpoint after a prior mitigation — the signal of an unkilled root cause. Needs at least 2 syncs of local history.

novel_features.name: Stale & Decaying Fleet
novel_features.description: Ranks endpoints by a composite decay score — last-seen age, last-scan age, out-of-date agent version, and reduced or disabled protection — so the riskiest agents triage first.

novel_features.name: Protection Coverage Gaps
novel_features.description: Lists endpoints in detect-only mode, with self-protection off, or with Ranger/firewall/device-control disabled — the 'are we actually protecting everyone?' compliance view per tenant.

novel_features.name: Version Rollout Tracker
novel_features.description: Shows agent-version distribution per site over time and flags sites stuck on EOL/old versions or stalled mid-upgrade-wave. Needs at least 2 syncs of local history.

novel_features.name: MTTR & Triage SLA
novel_features.description: Computes mean time from threat detection to mitigation per site, and flags SLA breaches and the longest-unresolved threats. Needs at least 2 syncs of local history.

novel_features.name: Unmanaged Exposure Map
novel_features.description: Surfaces unmanaged/rogue endpoints on each subnet by cross-referencing Ranger-discovered devices against managed agents, ranked by managed-peer density.

novel_features.name: Blast Radius
novel_features.description: For one threat, instantly shows every endpoint it touched, which are mitigated vs still active, the affected sites/groups, and the spread timeline.

novel_features.name: Tenant Posture Scorecard
novel_features.description: A one-page per-tenant rollup — agent health %, coverage %, open-threat count, oldest unresolved, version compliance — for the morning MSSP review or a client QBR.

novel_features.name: Verdict Reconciliation
novel_features.description: Flags threats whose analyst verdict, confidence level, or incident status changed since the last sync — suspicious to malicious, or an auto-mitigated threat re-opened — so nothing flips silently. Needs at least 2 syncs of local history.

novel_features.name: Triage Queue
novel_features.description: One ranked, cross-site worklist of every open threat — scored by confidence × severity × age — so the morning triage order needs zero console scope flips.

novel_features.name: Fleet Snapshot
novel_features.description: At-a-glance fleet counts — online/offline/decommissioned, infected, out-of-date, under-protected — across all sites in one call.

novel_features.name: Endpoint Dossier
novel_features.description: Everything about one endpoint on one card: agent state, full threat history, recent activities, and site/group membership — the IR handoff view.

novel_features.name: Exclusion Hygiene
novel_features.description: Flags risky exclusions — never matched by any threat, wildcard paths, and entries older than a threshold — the 'are we hiding real threats?' review.

novel_features.name: Site Risk Ranking
novel_features.description: Ranks sites/clients against each other by composite risk — open-threat density, coverage gaps, stale agents, MTTR — so you know which tenant to call first.

novel_features.name: License Reclaim
novel_features.description: Lists agents that still hold a license but no live machine uses: disconnected, with a last check-in past a threshold. Grouped per site (by site id, so two accounts' same-named sites stay apart) with a reclaimable-seat count; a newer record with the same endpoint name is shown as context, never as a reason to list a seat.

novel_features.name: Upgrade Worklist
novel_features.description: For a target agent version (default: the newest version seen per OS, since each OS ships its own package), lists the agents still behind it per site and OS, and sets aside offline agents an upgrade job could not reach.
